name: s2b_read
purpose: TASKS 53: S2b's registered read (PreRegistration_2026-10-19_S2b_Learning_Curve.md, 'Read'; probes/s2b_read.py) on S2 and S2b together, once the 23 S2b xtb force fields were in (12 Nov 01:42; the user, 11 Nov: the read waits for the two missing ones). Inputs by probes/s2b_read_inputs.sh: GVPT2 labels G and X of the 23 S2b molecules (solver sha256 937c176f, as S2's) and sets.json
command: echo "=== (S2BR) start $(date '+%F %T')" && cd ../../.. && PYTHONUTF8=1 python probes/s2b_read.py --sets probes/results_m1/s2b_read_2026-11-12/sets.json --out probes/results_m1/s2b_read_2026-11-12/read && echo "=== (S2BR) done $(date '+%F %T')"

estimate.basis: a lower bound: a foreground try on the laptop (12 Nov 02:2x) had not finished after 9 min 40 s; the nested search trains the network per fold and the curves draw 20 subsets per k for four models in two scopes

memory.basis: an estimate, not capped: one CPU python with torch (this laptop's rung C trainer processes hold 1.5-2.5 GB) and the 37 molecules' mode arrays (under 100 MB)
